hooks.command: bash -lc 'ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; while [ -n "$ROOT" ] && [ "$ROOT" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$ROOT/.codex/scripts/sprint-status-gate.sh" ]; do ROOT="$(dirname "$ROOT")"; done; if [ -f "$ROOT/.codex/scripts/sprint-status-gate.sh" ]; then cd "$ROOT" && bash .codex/scripts/sprint-status-gate.sh; else cat >/dev/null; exit 0; fi'
